reels.title: Transformers Stop Thinking Too Early, and a Tiny LoRA Fixes It

editorial_notes.reasoning: This paper offers a high-impact, counter-intuitive insight that perfectly aligns with 'multimodal_diffusion' interest. It proposes a 'LoRA fix' to make transformers think longer, which is visually translatable into dynamic depth-expansion animations.
editorial_notes.recommended_hook: What if your AI is actually 'bored' and skipping the hard thinking steps?
editorial_notes.suggested_everyday_analogy: A student reading a dense textbook who skips the middle chapters vs. one who uses a bookmark to focus on deep processing.
